summary: An 11.2 m two-axle double-decker city bus: one lofted monocoque with rounded front corners and a crowned roof… joints door_f_a, door_f_b, door_m_a, door_m_b, steering, wheel_f_l_roll, …; options paint; sockets seat_driver, eye_point, seat_pax_1, seat_pax_2, seat_pax_3, seat_pax_4, ….
setup: Spawn it with Prefabs.double_decker_bus or place "prefab": "double_decker_bus" in a scene; Game(plugins=[...]) needs physics3d(), vehicles().
